error.VALIDATION_ERROR: The request is not in a valid format.
error.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource could not be found.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
error.SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: This feature is not set up on the server.
error.IR_CHART_NOT_FOUND: The chart could not be found.
error.IR_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: The player could not be found.
error.IR_SCORE_NOT_FOUND: The score could not be found.
error.IR_REPLAY_NOT_FOUND: The replay could not be found.
error.IR_SETTING_NOT_FOUND: The settings blob could not be found.
error.IR_COURSE_NOT_FOUND: The course could not be found.
error.IR_TABLE_NOT_FOUND: The difficulty table could not be found.
error.IR_FOLDER_NOT_FOUND: The folder could not be found.
error.IR_FOLDER_NAME_TAKEN: A folder with the same name already exists.
error.IR_FOLDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The folder limit has been exceeded.
error.IR_FOLDER_CONFLICT: This folder was changed somewhere else first. Please reload it.
error.IR_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The request body is larger than allowed.
error.IR_CHART_PATTERN_INVALID: The chart pattern does not match the requested chart.
error.IR_TRACE_MISMATCH: The judgment trace does not match the score record it is linked to.
error.AI_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND: No AI key is registered. Please register a key in Settings.
error.AI_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: The AI key is wrong or has been revoked. Please register it again in Settings.
error.AI_PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN: The AI provider blocked requests from this key. Check the key's permissions or its model access.
error.AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The selected AI model does not exist or is no longer offered. Please choose a model again in Settings.
error.AI_PROVIDER_BAD_REQUEST: The AI provider did not accept the request. Choose another model or try again in a moment.
error.AI_PROVIDER_QUOTA: The AI provider account has reached its balance or spending limit.
error.AI_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The AI provider is holding back requests for now. Please try again in a moment.
error.AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not connect to the AI provider. Please try again in a moment.
error.AI_PROVIDER_REFUSED: The AI model refused to answer.
error.AI_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The AI output reached its limit and was cut off.
error.AI_OUTPUT_INVALID: The AI output was not in a valid format, so no interpretation could be made.
error.AI_USAGE_LIMIT: The AI usage limit has been reached.
error.AI_NOT_ENOUGH_DATA: There are not enough records to interpret yet. The AI was not called.
